source_title: Will There Be an American Horror Story Season 14? Everything We Know About the Anthology Series’ Future - People.com
source_excerpt:
‘American Horror Story’ season 13 aired its finale on Oct. 29
The American Horror Story season 13 finale aired on Oct. 29
The FX anthology series has been renewed for another season
Co-creator Ryan Murphy has said he wants to do the show “forever”
American Horror Story is continuing its nightmare-inducing mayhem.
The FX anthology series, created by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk , premiered in October 2011 and wrapped its 13th season on Oct. 29. Each installment has focused on a new eerie tale, from a murder house and witch coven to a traveling freak show and haunted hotel.
Season 13 featured several actors from previous seasons who reprised their iconic roles, including Sarah Paulson , Jessica Lange and Evan Peters . Meanwhile, Love Story star Paul Anthony Kelly and Riverdale actress Madelaine Petsch , among others, made their American Horror Story debuts .
While season 13 isn’t the final installment, Murphy has said he’ll “never” make another all-star season.
“This season is a tribute to all of the seasons, which we’ll never do again,” he told The Hollywood Reporter in August 2026. “But it was fun. It was like getting the band back together, and once they got on the set with me, it was like we never stopped making this. Most of them had accents, and they instantly fell back into their characters. It was fascinating and thrilling.”
Here’s everything we know about American Horror Story season 14, so far.
Will there be an American Horror Story season 14?
Yes, FX renewed American Horror Story for season 14 one week before the season 13 finale, per Deadline .
Previously, American Horror Story was renewed for seasons 11, 12 and 13 in January 2020, meaning the pickup is the show’s first in nearly seven years.
When season 13 premiered on Sept. 24, the launch became the show’s best streaming premiere ever, garnering 4 million views worldwide across Hulu and Disney+ in the four days following the release, according to FX’s internal data (via The Hollywood Reporter ).
What has Ryan Murphy said about more seasons of American Horror Story ?
Murphy told The Hollywood Reporter in October 2026 that he’s not interested in doing another all-star format after the season 13 finale.
“I like how it ends with a lot of the characters,” he said. “Some of them live, some of them die. So I think it would be different with other seasons.”
However, Murphy hopes to do the show “forever” and wants to take the franchise international for season 14, he told the outlet .
“I love doing it,” Murphy said. “I’m interested in: what is an international version of Horror Story ? That’s something I’m writing right now, maybe, but I don’t know — I just like branching out.”
When will American Horror Story season 14 be released?
FX has not yet announced an official release date for American Horror Story season 14.
Season 13 premiered in September and ended in October.
Meanwhile, season 12 was released in two parts — in October 2023 and April 2024 — due to production delays caused by the SAG-AFTRA strike , per The Wrap . Before that, season 11 premiered in October 2022 and ended in November of that year.

All 13 seasons of American Horror Story are available to stream on Hulu and Disney+ .
